entries.dialogueText: “Sounds fantastic. The President arriving to Lachaven in the driver's seat would make the headlines for sure.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was finally happening. Tomorrow..."
entries.dialogueText: It was finally happening. Tomorrow would be the grand opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed rail.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Symon and Gus, who had heavily assi..."
entries.dialogueText: Symon and Gus, who had heavily assisted in the project, had come to discuss the ceremony plans with Lucian and myself.

entries.dialogueText: “I don't support anything beyond the opening ceremony. The railway's completion speaks for itself.”

entries.dialogueText: I entered the cab and took a seat with the assistant beside me. The crowd was trying to catch a glimpse of me through the window.

entries.dialogueText: “Alright then. We have a lot of work to do. See you tomorrow morning.”

entries.dialogueText: “It's been a long time since the last successful infrastructure project. From a public relations point of view, we can certainly capitalize on the occasion.”

entries.dialogueText: Symon walked up beside me.

entries.dialogueText: “I'm honored. It will be great to arrive in Lachaven with the President of Sordland.”

entries.dialogueText: “I want to have Symon in the cab.”
entries.menuText: “I want to have Symon in the cab.”

entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Who do you want to travel with in..."
entries.dialogueText: “Who do you want to travel with in the cab, Mr. President?”

entries.dialogueText: “Lucian, I want you to ride with me.”
entries.menuText: “Lucian, I want you to ride with me.”

entries.speaker: Symon Holl
entries.title: Symon Holl: "“This isn't necessary, but I won't..."
entries.dialogueText: “This isn't necessary, but I won't refuse. We can talk about future economic projects.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Thank you, Mr. President. It will..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, Mr. President. It will be a good journey. We can talk about the election campaign preparations.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I agree. Get me on that train.""
entries.dialogueText: “I agree. Get me on that train."
entries.menuText: “I agree. Get me on that train."

entries.title: Player: "“I'd prefer we just do the opening..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'd prefer we just do the opening ceremony. No need for senseless spectacle.”
entries.menuText: “I'd prefer we just do the opening ceremony. No need for senseless spectacle.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Sure. We will be in the other carr..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sure. We will be in the other carriages. See you in Lachaven.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thanks to this railway, thousands..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thanks to this railway, thousands of new jobs have been and will continue to be created."
entries.menuText: “Thanks to this railway, thousands of new jobs have been and will continue to be created."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gus sauntered over to the podium an..."
entries.dialogueText: Gus sauntered over to the podium and leaned into the microphone.

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to this railway, travel between Holsord and Lachaven is now twice as fast and endlessly more comfortable."

entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Of course. We'll hold the ceremony..."
entries.dialogueText: “Of course. We'll hold the ceremony and open the upgraded railway to the public immediately after.”

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: "“Very well.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Very well.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Ensuring the success of this proje..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ensuring the success of this project wasn't just one of my presidential goals -- it was my personal priority."

entries.menuText: Walk to the podium.

entries.dialogueText: Lucian's voice echoed in the central station. Thousands of Sordland and USP flags began to wave as the loud cheers intensified.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The new train was in pristine condi..."
entries.dialogueText: The new train was in pristine condition. Its electric engine provided the smoothest ride I'd ever had.

entries.speaker: Gus Manger
entries.title: Gus Manger: "“This railway project is a perfect..."
entries.dialogueText: “This railway project is a perfect example of how we can bring prosperity to the under-developed areas between our major cities.”

entries.menuText: “See you at the ceremony.”

entries.dialogueText: “Additionally, a large crowd has been invited to the ceremony and will be watching the opening speech.”

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: After an uneventful four hours on board, we were welcomed by a throng of citizens at Lachaven station.

entries.dialogueText: Lucian took my place on the stage to close the ceremony.

entries.dialogueText: “Once we cut that ribbon and the citizens of Holsord get on the train, I believe you'll agree we have succeeded."

entries.menuText: “People of Sordland! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway.”

entries.dialogueText: We all dispersed in order to prepare for the big day.

entries.menuText: “We built this railway to create economic growth throughout the Greater Holsord and Gelsland regions."

entries.dialogueText: “Without further ado, I invite the President of Sordland to the stage.”

entries.dialogueText: “I want to acknowledge the brilliant mind behind this project, the esteemed Minister of Economy and Tax, Symon Holl. Please come over here.”
entries.menuText: “I want to acknowledge the brilliant mind behind this project, the esteemed Minister of Economy and Tax, Symon Holl. Please come over here.”

entries.menuText: “Holsordians! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the L-1 High-speed railway.”

entries.dialogueText: “None of this would be possible without the sound advice of my cabinet member Gus Manger. Please come over here.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Like the good old campaign days.”"

entries.dialogueText: “We will show our best face tomorrow. Meanwhile, I'll make sure that our message about improving the countryside gets across.”

entries.dialogueText: The chanting from the crowd continued. Some were yelling the motto of Holsord: High above all.

entries.dialogueText: “At the beginning of this journey, we promised jobs and opportunity. We kept our promise.”

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: “Our intention with the L-1 Railway was to allow citizens to easily commute between the major cities of Holsord and Lachaven.”
entries.menuText: “Our intention with the L-1 Railway was to allow citizens to easily commute between the major cities of Holsord and Lachaven.”

entries.dialogueText: “Things were certainly easier back then.”

entries.menuText: “Symon, you deserve the credit. After all, it was you who came up with the project.”

entries.dialogueText: “Thank you for your kind words. It truly means a good deal.”

entries.dialogueText: “Beginning with the President who put his trust in me, I want to thank all who were involved in L-1.”
